```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_scores_means
title: >
  Describe the Scores Again
questions:
  - id: mean_comparison
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Compare your answer
    prompt: >
      The mean completion times are 10 seconds for the easy test and 100 seconds
      for the hard test. Your times were 8 and 70 seconds. With this extra
      information, how would you describe your performances? Why?
    hint: >
      What do the averages tell you that the two times alone didn't? What do they still not tell you?
    answer: >
      You were faster than average on both tests: 2 seconds faster on the easy
      test and 30 seconds faster on the hard one. Whether one performance is more impressive than the other is still
      harder to judge.
```
